summary: Removed the large grass-tile mouseover info panel.
Added Quest Clipboard as an early automation seed shop purchase.
Quest Clipboard automatically claims up to 2 ready quest rewards every 9 seconds.
Manual and automated quest claims now share applyQuestReward.
Added Auto-Pilot as a fifth automation directive.
Auto-Pilot resolves dynamically to Growth, Harvest, Supplies, or Balanced based on field state and resources.
Sprinkler and companion automation now use the resolved directive when Auto-Pilot is selected.
Automation panel and compact status show the resolved mode, for example Auto-Pilot -> Harvest.
The automation directive quest still counts only the original four core directives.

verification: npm run build passed locally after Auto-Pilot changes.
Browser stress-mode check passed with no console warnings.
known_untracked_files_left_local: docs/Strategieen voor Geavanceerde Automatisering in Incrementele Games.md
recent_design_direction: Keep the field less cluttered: important resources stay visible, detail text moves out of constant field view.
Automation should feel smarter and more helpful rather than only faster.
Visual polish should stay crisp and readable, with punchy effects but less intrusive UI chrome.
Pacing should remain faster than the earlier nerfed state, especially for early seeds and first automation unlocks.

next_session_brainstorm.why: Give the player satisfying operational control without micromanagement.
next_session_brainstorm.possible_shape: A small automation panel section that lets players queue priorities like gather seeds until 20, push growth until 80 percent grown, then harvest.

next_session_brainstorm.why: The skill tree now branches well; a dedicated automation branch could create longer-term goals.
next_session_brainstorm.possible_shape: Nodes that improve Auto-Pilot decisions, Quest Clipboard claim rate, sprinkler radius, companion sync bursts, and reduced downtime.

next_session_brainstorm.why: Short lived events can make the board feel alive without permanent UI clutter.
next_session_brainstorm.possible_shape: Mini weather pockets, shiny patches, migrating companion trails, or a brief seed gust that Auto-Pilot can react to.

next_session_brainstorm.why: Auto-Pilot is functional now, but it could use a more readable emotional beat.
next_session_brainstorm.possible_shape: A tiny mode-change pulse or short status toast when Auto-Pilot changes from Growth to Harvest, throttled so it does not spam.

next_session_brainstorm.why: Seed gain was improved, but the next session should play the first 10 minutes and feel where friction remains.
next_session_brainstorm.possible_shape: Tune costs around Seed Pouch, Sprinkler, Field Journal, Quest Clipboard, Weather Jar, and first companion.

suggested_next_step: Start next session by playing a fresh save for 5-10 minutes, focusing on the path from Seed Pouch to Sprinkler to Quest Clipboard to first companion. Tune costs only after feeling that loop.
